pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.answer: yes. Mentor assignment: PAR Mentors assigned to first-time, probationary, and new contract teachers. Duration: Mentors serve up to five years; PDP/Guided PDP/PSP timelines vary. Release time/stipend: not_discussed. Required meetings: PDP/PSP teams meet regularly (at least four during PSP), plus pre/post-conferences.
pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: PAR Mentor Services May be Provided to: 1. first time teachers; 2. contract teachers who have had experience in the Minneapolis Public Schools in another job classification and are moving into a new position; 3. first year contract teachers who have teaching experience outside the District; ... support the annual New Teacher Orientation, 'Teacher-To-New Teacher Guide Online', facilitation of New Teacher Professional Development, New Teacher Networks, Reserve Teacher Training, Professional Development Centers, other staff development sessions, and interactive online mentoring support.

pd_teacher_leadership_002.answer: yes. Roles: PAR Mentors, Teacher Emeriti, Demonstration Teachers, Teacher Development Council. Selection: PAR Committee administers selection/induction for PAR Mentors and Teacher Emeriti; sites involved in building mentor selection. Duties: Model/demonstrate practices, mentor teachers, govern PAR processes, provide training. Time/Compensation: Compensation and specific release time not discussed in this section.
pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: The PAR Committee is responsible for the process of selecting, inducting, assigning, assessing and supporting PAR mentors, including the Lead Mentor. ... identification and coordination of a cadre of Demonstration Teachers within the District. Demonstration Teachers are teachers who use exemplary practices in their classrooms and who are willing to model and discuss those practices for colleagues; ... provide recognition of exemplary service of teacher leaders (or teachers in leadership roles) ... work with the Teacher Development Council to support the pre-service programs of teacher preparation and induction;
